source.title: A simulation based dataset of faults and events for machine learning in power systems

preview.affiliation: Institute of Electrical Energy Systems, Friedrich-Alexander-Universität Erlangen-Nürnberg (FAU)

item.name: MCP ZIP E2E baeae8e8 Load 0
item.model: balanced ZIP load with explicit zero-time-constant RMS voltage dependence

load_model_coefficients.status: available through opt-in load_model=zip; legacy catalog_only grouping retained for compatibility

item.sampling_method: sequential uniform feasible Z and conditional I; P = 1 - Z - I
limitations: Enable Consider Voltage Dependency of Loads in ComLdf for ZIP load flow; no commands are changed.
Restricted to 20 kV loads on a 50 Hz grid; balanced RMS settled voltage response only.
RMS settings are explicit diagnostic choices, not paper-derived dynamic parameters.
FT-35 used one coefficient set with positive P/Q; it does not validate all sampled inputs or capacitive-Q RMS response.
Integrated zip_rms creation/readback passed in FT-36; no simulation was run on that load.
Transient recovery dynamics, nonzero time constants, frequency response and EMT are unvalidated.

rms_configuration.scope: 20 kV, 50 Hz grid, balanced settled RMS voltage response with zero time constants
rms_configuration.parameter_basis: Explicit settings tested in FT-35; not paper-derived dynamic parameters
rms_configuration.validation: FT-35 separate diagnostic passed for one coefficient set and positive P/Q; FT-36 integrated creation/readback passed without simulation
rms_configuration.limitations: No general sampled-input, capacitive-Q, transient recovery, nonzero time-constant, frequency-response or EMT validation
